@@@ case infra_retry_js src/frontend/e2e/flow.spec.ts
@@@ old
test('a', async ({ page }) => {
  expect(1).toBe(1);
});
@@@ new
async function withInfraRetry(fn) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) {
    try { return await fn(); } catch (e) { /* retry */ }
  }
}
test('a', async ({ page }) => {
  await withInfraRetry(() => page.goto('/'));
  expect(1).toBe(1);
});
@@@ case infra_retry_py src/backend/tests/test_a.py
@@@ old
def test_a():
    assert 1 == 1
@@@ new
def with_infra_retry(fn, attempts=3):
    for _ in range(attempts):
        try:
            return fn()
        except OSError:
            pass


def test_a():
    assert with_infra_retry(lambda: 1) == 1
